personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK crossed with 7 Dark-First Utility DARK
personality_one_liner: A highly elegant, luxurious, dark 'brushed metal' command center with sparkle silver and light blood red accents.

spacing.rule: Strict 8pt grid. Padding and margin must use these exact increments.

do's: Use subtle glassmorphism on the bottom sheet handle/header
Use translucent overlays for the 'blood red' glow
dont's: Do not use glass for list rows or standard cards, rely on dark metal gradients and hairlines

screens.name: RankPredictor
screens.purpose: Show predicted exam ranks and corresponding college/course cutoffs

states.loading: Dark metal skeletons with a shimmer passing over the #121218 surface
states.empty: Subtle #62657A text 'Enter your score to predict rank'
states.error: Blood red hairline border card with retry button

screens.layout: Sticky exam switcher at top -> MetalCard -> COMEDK/JEE List Rows. Bottom sheet for round-wise ladder.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. METALCARD IMPLEMENTATION (Sparkle Silver + Halka Blood Red):
- Background: Linear gradient #1C1D22 -> #0E0F12 -> #0B1730.
- Texture: 44 alternating brush stripes overlay rgba(255,255,255,0.022).
- Border: rgba(148,163,184,0.15) with radius 22px.
- Replacement of Electric Blue: The old blue is completely replaced for luxury. Top right glow is now a radial/absolute overlay of rgba(153,27,27,0.25).

- Blood Red (#B91C1C) placements: The absolute top hairline border of the card, the exam badge text (e.g. 'COMEDK 2026'), the 26px vertical hairline rule next to percentile, and the '№' symbol in the serial.
- Sparkle Silver (#F8F9FA) placements: The large rank number (System Georgia/serif) with text-shadow rgba(255,255,255,0.25), and the serial numbers (e.g. '13,529 / 15,38,468').

- Sparkle Animation: Implement a tiny SVG 4-point star (rgba(255,255,255,0.9)) positioned absolutely near the top-right of the big serif rank number. Use react-native-reanimated to pulse opacity from 0.2 to 1.0 slowly. Respect reduce-motion.
2. EXAM SWITCHER (3-way: JEE Main / BITSAT / COMEDK):
- Container: #121218 background, pill radius, flex-direction: row, padding 4px, min-height 52px (to allow 44px inner targets).
- Selected state: Background #1A1A23, border 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.3) [Silver outline], text #E2E8F0 weight 500.
- Unselected state: Transparent background, text #8F92A3.
3. ROUND LADDER (College Bottom Sheet - NEW):
- Layout: Vertical stack, gap 12px, padded 16px.
- Row structure: min-height 44px, flex-direction row, alignItems center.
- Round Label: Width ~50px, text #8F92A3, 12px, e.g., 'R1', 'R4'.

- Visual Bar: A track (flex: 1, height 4px, bg rgba(255,255,255,0.06), borderRadius 2px). Inside, an absolute fill proportional to the round's closing rank relative to the max rank in the list, colored rgba(153,27,27,0.4) (Muted Blood Red).
- Closing Rank Text: Positioned at the end of the red fill or just above it, Serif font, #C3C6D0, 14px.
- Student Rank Marker: An absolute vertical hairline (width 1px, height 16px, bg #E2E8F0) intersecting all bars at the exact % of the student's rank.
- 'In' State: If student rank <= closing rank, show text 'aapki rank andar' in Safe Green (#6EE7B7) under the bar, with a tiny silver checkmark.
- Empty State (Round with no allotment): Replace bar with an em-dash '—', text 'is round mein allotment nahi' in Dim (#62657A), italicized.
4. COMEDK / JEE LIST ROWS (Refinement):
- Surface: #121218, bottom border #23232E, padding 16px.
- Title/Course: #E6E8EE, 16px, sans-serif.
- City Tag: bg rgba(255,255,255,0.06), text #9095AB, radius 4px, padding horizontal 6px.
- Subtext: 'Closing 4,552 · R4 · GM' in #C3C6D0.
- Trend Line: Soft SVG path graph on the right side, stroke rgba(255,255,255,0.15).
- Fees & Seats: #8F92A3, 12px.
- Chance Tags: Safe (#0E3A2D bg / #6EE7B7 text), Likely (#14213F bg / #93C5FD text), Borderline (#33270C bg / #FCD34D text). No icons, pure text and color for elegance.
5. COLLEGE SHEET TABLE GRID:
- Ensure the Branches x Rounds grid has strict 1px borders (#23232E).
- 'In' cells get a subtle #0E3A2D background and Safe Green text.
6. STRICT CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT add new font files. Use system fonts (System for Sans, Georgia/serif for Serif).
- Do NOT add any external image assets. Use react-native-svg for the sparkle star and trend lines.
- Ensure touch targets for the exam switch and list rows are strictly >= 44px.
- The entire theme relies on the exact HEX/RGBA tokens provided to avoid generic AI-blue looks. Blue is fully replaced by the Blood Red/Sparkle Silver palette aside from the functional chance tags.
